About IndieLab

IndieLab is a small, independent gift-guide and home-finds publication. We start from what people are actually searching for — on Pinterest, Google and Amazon — then write the guide we would want to read: who the gift suits, how to present it, what to check before buying, and an honest link to where it sells.

We publish through the holiday season and beyond: cozy home finds, beauty gifts, kitchen gadgets and the occasional viral product that turns out to be genuinely good.

How we make money

Guides contain Amazon affiliate links. If you buy through one, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. That is the whole business model — no paid placements, no sponsored rankings. See the affiliate disclosure.
